forum.title: GfxDesigner 4.26.1: STM32U5G9J-DK2-3.0.14.tpa creates intflash.elf with size ~400MB
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @ferro,

Thank you very much for raising this issue. We're looking into it. I'll let you know when we have found the cause and tell you when we'll patch it.
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I created a blank project for STM32U5G9J-DK2 and in process of programming the board, GfxDesigner generates 400MB file intflash.elf. With GfxDesigner 4.24.1 it is 4MB.

Why 4.26.1 generates  intflash.elf so large ? A bug ?

Thanks

![size.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c3ed50de-29b7-8976-9dce-285bf7f158b9.png "size.png")

![ex 4.26.1.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a2b71175-e523-c974-aec0-0bc319b734d0.png "ex 4.26.1.png")

Thank you very much for raising this issue. We're looking into it. I'll let you know when we have found the cause and tell you when we'll patch it.

Thank you for that @Osman SOYKURT . So it is not some problem with my install/machine

I am actually not using GfxDesigner flash/build functionality - only tried it out of curiosity and thought I let you know about this file size issue.
